📋 Usage Policy

StudyDeck Pro is for personal educational use only. All MCQ content is intended to assist in your NEET PG / INICET preparation. Redistribution or commercial use of questions is strictly prohibited.

🔒 Data Privacy

All your study data — questions, scores, notes, and progress — is stored locally on your device only. We do not collect, transmit, or sell any personal data. Your account credentials are managed securely via Firebase Authentication.

⚖️ Fair Use

Do not share your account login or passkey with others. Each account is for one user only. Sharing logins may result in permanent account suspension.

🤖 AI Features

The Ask AI feature copies your MCQ prompt and opens a third-party AI website (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) in a new tab. StudyDeck Pro does not operate or control those external services. Use them responsibly and per their own terms of service.

📱 Offline Access

Once logged in, the app functions offline for browsing and quizzing. An internet connection is required for initial login, Firebase sync, and AI features.

📊 Rank Estimation Model▾
⚠️ Rank, percentile, and cutoff-in-marks shown after a NEET PG mock are a statistical estimate, not official NBE data. The percentile requirement per category (50th for UR/EWS, 40th for OBC/SC/ST, etc.) is real, stable policy. The actual score each percentile lands on changes every year — this app estimates it using the model below. Adjust these if you have a better source (e.g. a coaching institute's known distribution), and always verify final numbers against your year's official NBEMS result.
Average score (%)
Typical candidate's score as % of total marks
38%
Score spread (SD)
How widely scores vary — higher = wider spread

📋 General Instructions
1.This is a Computer Based Test (CBT). All questions are of MCQ type with single correct answer.
2.Marking Scheme: Each correct answer carries +4 marks. Each wrong answer carries −1 mark. Un-attempted questions carry 0 marks.
3.You can navigate to any question at any time using the Question Palette (📋 button) during the exam.
4.You can change your answer at any time before final submission by clicking a different option.
5.Use "Mark for Review" (🔖) to bookmark questions for later — your answer (if any) will still be saved and counted.
6.The timer will count down from the allotted time. The exam will auto-submit when time expires.
7.Once you click "Submit Exam", the test cannot be resumed.
8.Results will include subject-wise analysis, rank estimate, and comparison with NEET PG 2024 cutoffs.

📖 How to Use StudyDeck
Complete guide · All features covered
🚀 Getting Started
1
Import a Deck
Tap the 📂 Import button on the Home screen or go to Library and tap Import. Supported formats: APKG (Anki), HTML (Marrow, DAMS), Excel (.xlsx), CSV.
2
Open Your Deck
Go to Library (bottom nav) → tap your deck → choose a study mode: Quiz, Flash, or Browse.
3
Track Your Progress
Visit Analytics (bottom nav) to see your daily streak, accuracy by subject, and score trends.
📚 Study Modes
📋 Browse Mode
Scroll through all MCQs in a deck. Tap any card to expand and see the correct answer, explanation, and images.

• Tap ⭐ Star to bookmark for later
• Tap 📝 Note to write a personal revision note
• Tap 🔍 AI Check to verify the question's accuracy
• Use the filter bar at the top to show only Practised, Unpractised, or Starred questions
🎯 Quiz Mode
Answer questions one by one. Tap an option → instant right/wrong feedback → explanation revealed.

• Rate difficulty after each question (Easy / Moderate / Hard) — feeds into analytics
• Tap ⭐ Star to bookmark tricky questions
• Tap 🔍 AI Check on any question to get Claude AI's accuracy review
• Tap 💬 Ask AI for a detailed concept explanation
• At the end: see score, review wrong answers, and export mistakes as CSV
🗂️ Flashcard Mode
Flip-card spaced repetition (SRS). See the question → recall the answer → flip to check.

• Rate each card: Again / Hard / Good / Easy
• Cards rated Again or Hard appear again sooner
• Use Study Due Only to focus on cards scheduled for today
• Progress bar shows session completion
🏥 NEET PG & Custom Tests
🎯 NEET PG Mock Test
Home → NEET Test → 180 questions, timed (3.5 hours), distributed across subjects matching real NEET PG pattern.

• Question Palette (top right): see all question statuses — answered, marked, unanswered
• Mark & Next: flag a question to revisit before submitting
• Clear: remove your selection for the current question
• Timer counts down — exam auto-submits when time expires
• After submit: full scorecard with subject-wise breakdown, rank, and review mode
🛠️ Custom Test
Home → Custom Test → set your own rules:

• Choose number of questions (10 – 200)
• Select specific subjects or decks
• Set a time limit or go untimed
• Same exam-mode interface as NEET PG test
• Results saved to Analytics automatically
🤖 AI-Powered Tools
🔍 AI MCQ Checker
Available in Browse and Quiz. Tap 🔍 AI Check this MCQ → Claude AI reviews the question for:

• Incorrect answer key
• Outdated medical information
• Errors or ambiguity in the explanation
• Suggested corrections with reasoning

If errors are found, tap Apply AI Corrections to update the question in your deck permanently.
💬 Ask AI
Tap Ask AI on any question to open a chat with Claude AI.

• Ask for concept explanation, mnemonics, or clinical correlations
• Ask follow-up questions in the same session
• Get differential diagnosis tips or pathophysiology breakdowns
• Useful when the explanation is unclear or too brief
📁 Library & Deck Management
Managing Decks
In Library, each deck card shows the question count, last studied date, and study stats.

• ✏️ Rename: tap the pencil icon on a deck card
• 🗑️ Delete: tap the trash icon — permanently removes all questions
• Subdeck tree: decks imported from Marrow/DAMS HTML files are automatically organized as folders — tap a folder to drill into subjects and chapters
Importing Formats
• APKG: drag/drop or tap import — Anki decks with images fully supported
• HTML: Marrow edition exports, DAMS HTML files — images auto-extracted
• Excel / CSV: custom columns mapped automatically
• JSON backup: restore a full StudyDeck backup file
📝 Notes & Bookmarks
Personal Notes
Tap 📝 Note on any question in Browse or Quiz. Type your revision note and save. Notes are stored permanently per question — a dot indicator shows which questions have notes.
⭐ Starred Questions
Star any question in Browse or Quiz. In Browse, switch the filter to Starred to review only your bookmarked questions. Great for creating a personal "high-yield" list before exams.
📊 Analytics
What Analytics Shows
• Study Streak: daily heatmap calendar and current streak count
• Accuracy Trend: score graph over recent sessions
• Subject Breakdown: accuracy ring and score per subject
• Weak Areas: automatically flagged topics where accuracy is below 60%
• Session History: every quiz/test is logged with date, score, and time taken
⬇️ Export & Backup
Export Options
Settings → Export → choose format:

• PDF: print-ready with images, formatted for A4/mobile reading
• Excel (.xlsx): all questions with options, answer key, and explanation
• CSV: comma-separated for Anki or spreadsheet import
• Wrong Answers CSV: only the questions you got wrong — targeted revision
Backup & Restore
Settings → Export full backup → saves a .json file with all decks, scores, notes, and settings.

To restore: Settings → Import → select your backup .json file. All data is restored exactly.
⚙️ Settings
Customisation Options
• Theme: switch between Dark and Light mode
• Accent Colour: choose from Blue, Violet, Cyan, Green, Gold, Red
• Font Size: increase or decrease quiz question font for readability
• AI Model: choose which AI model powers the checker and Ask AI
• Study Reminder: set a daily notification to keep your streak alive
• Reset Progress: clear scores only, or full reset (keeps decks)
💡 Pro Tips
Before any exam: Run a Custom Test on your weak subjects. Use the Wrong Answers CSV to create a targeted revision list.
Daily habit: 30 questions in Quiz mode → rate difficulty → check Analytics. Consistent small sessions beat occasional long ones.
Marrow HTML import: Export subject-wise from Marrow → import HTML → the app auto-organises chapters as subdecks.
AI Check wisely: Use it when an answer "feels wrong" or when two options both seem correct — it often catches outdated answer keys.
Backup weekly: Settings → Export full backup → save to Google Drive. Protects all your progress from accidental browser data loss.
